issues.issue: Header misprint; extractor's reading confirmed. The page has only one column. Its reconciliation (148,929 + 22,917 + 26,005 = 197,851 - 162,832 = 35,019) uses the 2023 balance sheet (p2). On the continuation page (p5), operating income 80,014 and depreciation 35,555 match the 2023 statement of revenues and expenses (p3). All sections add up (113,113 - 24,298 - 88,101 + 13,515 = 14,229; 20,790 + 14,229 = 35,019). This is an assumption only a reader of the page can confirm, so it is listed as a warning.
